title: Attention Is All You Need
summary: The Transformer replaces recurrence with attention, creating a more parallelizable sequence model and strong translation results.
summary_en: The Transformer replaces recurrence with attention, creating a more parallelizable sequence model and strong translation results.

nodes.label: Sequential bottleneck
nodes.detail: Recurrent sequence models process positions sequentially, which limits parallelization during training. The paper identifies this as the fundamental constraint of sequential computation.
nodes.detail_en: Recurrent sequence models process positions sequentially, which limits parallelization during training. The paper identifies this as the fundamental constraint of sequential computation.
nodes.quote: The fundamental constraint of sequential computation, however, remains.
nodes.detail_zh: 循环序列模型按位置依次处理输入，限制了训练时的并行化。论文将其称为序列计算的根本约束

nodes.label: Transformer architecture
nodes.detail: The proposed Transformer is based solely on attention mechanisms and removes recurrence and convolution from the sequence transduction architecture.
nodes.detail_en: The proposed Transformer is based solely on attention mechanisms and removes recurrence and convolution from the sequence transduction architecture.
nodes.quote: based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely
nodes.detail_zh: 论文提出完全基于注意力机制的 Transformer，去掉序列转换架构中的循环和卷积。

nodes.label: Encoder-decoder stacks
nodes.detail: The encoder and decoder each contain N = 6 layers. Every sub-layer produces dmodel = 512 dimensional representations, with residual connections and layer normalization.
nodes.detail_en: The encoder and decoder each contain N = 6 layers. Every sub-layer produces dmodel = 512 dimensional representations, with residual connections and layer normalization.
nodes.detail_zh: 编码器和解码器各包含 N = 6 层。每个子层输出 dmodel = 512 维表示，并使用残差连接和层归一化。

nodes.label: Multi-head attention
nodes.detail: The model runs h = 8 attention heads in parallel. Each head uses dk = dv = 64, while the combined representation remains dmodel = 512.
nodes.detail_en: The model runs h = 8 attention heads in parallel. Each head uses dk = dv = 64, while the combined representation remains dmodel = 512.
nodes.quote: The output is computed as a weighted sum of the values.
nodes.detail_zh: 模型并行运行 h = 8 个注意力头。每个头使用 dk = dv = 64，合并后的表示维度仍为 dmodel = 512。

nodes.label: Positional encoding
nodes.detail: Without recurrence or convolution, the model adds sinusoidal positional encodings so token order remains available to the network.
nodes.detail_en: Without recurrence or convolution, the model adds sinusoidal positional encodings so token order remains available to the network.
nodes.quote: The wavelengths form a geometric progression from 2π to 10000 · 2π.
nodes.detail_zh: 由于没有循环或卷积，模型加入正弦位置编码，让网络保留词元顺序信息。

nodes.label: Parallel computation
nodes.detail: Self-attention has O(n^2 · d) per-layer operations, O(1) sequential operations, and O(1) maximum path length, compared with O(n) sequential operations for recurrent layers.
nodes.detail_en: Self-attention has O(n^2 · d) per-layer operations, O(1) sequential operations, and O(1) maximum path length, compared with O(n) sequential operations for recurrent layers.
nodes.detail_zh: 自注意力每层的运算量为 O(n^2 · d)，顺序运算为 O(1)，最大路径长度为 O(1)；循环层需要 O(n) 次顺序运算。

nodes.label: WMT translation results
nodes.detail: The best model reaches 28.4 BLEU on WMT 2014 English-to-German and 41.8 BLEU on English-to-French after 3.5 days on 8 GPUs.
nodes.detail_en: The best model reaches 28.4 BLEU on WMT 2014 English-to-German and 41.8 BLEU on English-to-French after 3.5 days on 8 GPUs.
nodes.detail_zh: 最佳模型在 WMT 2014 英德翻译上达到 28.4 BLEU，在英法翻译上达到 41.8 BLEU，并在 8 个 GPU 上训练 3.5 天。

nodes.label: Parsing generalization
nodes.detail: On English constituency parsing, a 4-layer Transformer reaches 91.3 F1 in the WSJ-only setting and 92.7 F1 in the semi-supervised setting.
nodes.detail_en: On English constituency parsing, a 4-layer Transformer reaches 91.3 F1 in the WSJ-only setting and 92.7 F1 in the semi-supervised setting.
nodes.detail_zh: 在英文成分句法分析上，4 层 Transformer 在仅 WSJ 设置达到 91.3 F1，在半监督设置达到 92.7 F1。

nodes.label: Attention replaces recurrence
nodes.detail: The paper presents attention-only sequence transduction as a strong and more parallelizable alternative to recurrent and convolutional architectures.
nodes.detail_en: The paper presents attention-only sequence transduction as a strong and more parallelizable alternative to recurrent and convolutional architectures.
nodes.quote: attention, replacing recurrent layers with multi-headed self-attention
nodes.detail_zh: 论文展示了只使用注意力的序列转换模型，成为循环和卷积架构的高并行替代方案。

summary_zh: Transformer 用注意力取代循环结构，让序列模型更易并行训练，并在机器翻译上取得强劲结果。
